panels.title: At a glance — audit posture (7-day window)
Audit log tampering (AU-9)
panels.description: Windows 1102 (Security log cleared) / 1104 (log full). MUST be zero — any value is an incident.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS tampering FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id IN (1102, 1104) AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: AWS root usage (AC-6)
panels.description: CloudTrail events by the root principal. Expected zero; investigate every occurrence (CIS 1.7).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS root_events FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE principal_type = 'Root' AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: Failed logons — Windows (AC-7)
panels.description: Security 4625 count. Sustained spikes = brute force / spray.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS failed FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id = 4625 AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: Failed auth — Linux (AC-7)
panels.description: sshd/login/su failures from journald.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS failed FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE identifier IN ('sshd', 'login', 'su') AND (positionCaseInsensitive(message, 'fail') > 0 OR message LIKE '%Invalid user%') AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: GuardDuty high severity (SI-4)
panels.description: Findings with severity >= 7. Zero is the goal; any value needs triage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS high_sev FROM siem.guardduty WHERE severity >= 7 AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: Events ingested (AU-12)
panels.description: Total events captured across all committed sources in the window — generation is happening.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM siem.windows_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)) + (SELECT count() FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)) + (SELECT count() FROM siem.k8s_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)) + (SELECT count() FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time)) AS total

panels.title: Logons: success vs failure (AU-2 | 4624 / 4625)
panels.description: Hourly logon outcomes across all Windows hosts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, if(event_id = 4624, 'success', 'failure') AS outcome, count() AS logons FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id IN (4624, 4625) AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t, outcome ORDER BY t

panels.title: Failed logon detail (AC-7 | 4625)
panels.description: Who failed to log on, from where, and how (logon_type 2=interactive, 3=network, 10=RDP).

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, computer, user_name, src_ip, logon_type FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id = 4625 AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Account management (AC-2 | 4720–4767)
panels.description: User/group lifecycle: creations, deletions, group membership, lockouts. Review every row weekly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, computer, multiIf(event_id = 4720, 'User created', event_id = 4722, 'User enabled', event_id = 4723, 'Password change attempt', event_id = 4724, 'Password reset', event_id = 4725, 'User disabled', event_id = 4726, 'User deleted', event_id = 4728, 'Added to global group', event_id = 4732, 'Added to local group', event_id = 4738, 'Account changed', event_id = 4740, 'Account locked out', event_id = 4767, 'Account unlocked', 'Other') AS action, user_name, left(message, 80) AS detail FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id IN (4720, 4722, 4723, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4728, 4732, 4738, 4740, 4767) AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Service installs & scheduled tasks (AU-2 | 4697–4702)
panels.description: New services (4697) and scheduled task create/delete/update (4698/4699/4702) — persistence mechanisms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, computer, event_id, user_name, left(message, 70) AS detail FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id IN (4697, 4698, 4699, 4702) AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Privileged use (AC-6 | 4672–4674)
panels.description: Special-privilege logons and privileged service calls per hour. Watch the shape, not the count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, count() AS privileged FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id IN (4672, 4673, 4674) AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: PowerShell execution (AU-2 | 4103 / 4104)
panels.description: Module and script-block logging volume. Spikes outside admin hours deserve a look.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, count() AS ps_events FROM siem.windows_events WHERE channel = 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Process creation (AU-2 | 4688)
panels.description: Requires 'Audit Process Creation' policy on hosts. Flat zero = policy not enabled (finding, not silence).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, count() AS proc_creates FROM siem.windows_events WHERE event_id = 4688 AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Authentication outcomes (AC-7 | sshd / login / su)
panels.description: Hourly auth events split by outcome (message heuristic on journald).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, if(positionCaseInsensitive(message, 'fail') > 0 OR message LIKE '%Invalid user%', 'failure', 'other') AS outcome, count() AS events FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE identifier IN ('sshd', 'login', 'su') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t, outcome ORDER BY t

panels.title: Privilege escalation: sudo (AC-6)
panels.description: Every sudo invocation shipped by journald. auditd USER_CMD records appear in Identity changes when the kernel audit subsystem exists.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, host, left(message, 110) AS command FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE identifier = 'sudo' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Identity changes (AC-2 | auditd ADD_USER / DEL_USER / *_MGMT)
panels.description: auditd account-lifecycle records. Also includes USER_CMD (sudo via auditd) where present.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, host, audit_type, user_name, left(message, 80) AS detail FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE audit_type IN ('ADD_USER', 'DEL_USER', 'ADD_GROUP', 'DEL_GROUP', 'USER_MGMT', 'GRP_MGMT', 'USER_CHAUTHTOK', 'USER_CMD') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Service state failures (AU-2 | systemd)
panels.description: Units that failed to start/run — service-tampering and stability signal.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, host, unit, left(message, 90) AS detail FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE identifier = 'systemd' AND positionCaseInsensitive(message, 'failed') > 0 AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Audit subsystem changes (AU-9)
panels.description: auditd DAEMON_START/DAEMON_END/CONFIG_CHANGE. Non-zero = the audit pipeline itself changed; verify it was sanctioned.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS audit_changes FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE audit_type IN ('DAEMON_START', 'DAEMON_END', 'CONFIG_CHANGE') AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: AWS (siem.cloudtrail / guardduty / vpc_flow / s3_access — populates at AWS go-live)
Console logins (AC-7 | ConsoleLogin)
panels.description: Management-console sign-ins, success vs failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, if(error_message = '', 'success', 'failure') AS outcome, count() AS logins FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE event_name = 'ConsoleLogin' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t, outcome ORDER BY t

panels.title: Authorization failures (AC-3 | AccessDenied)
panels.description: AccessDenied / UnauthorizedOperation across all management events — probing indicator.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, count() AS denied FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE error_code IN ('AccessDenied', 'UnauthorizedOperation', 'Client.UnauthorizedOperation', 'AccessDeniedException') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: IAM changes (AC-2 | iam.amazonaws.com writes)
panels.description: Non-read-only IAM calls: users, roles, policies, keys.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, event_name, principal_arn, source_ip, error_code FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE event_source = 'iam.amazonaws.com' AND read_only = false AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: GuardDuty findings (SI-4)
panels.description: All findings in window, worst first. Severity: >=7 high, 4–6.9 medium, <4 low.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, severity, finding_type, resource_id, title FROM siem.guardduty WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY severity DESC, event_time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Root activity detail (AC-6)
panels.description: Every root-principal event. Pairs with the at-a-glance counter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, event_name, source_ip FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE principal_type = 'Root' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Network denials (SC-7 | VPC Flow REJECT)
panels.description: Rejected flows per hour across in-scope VPCs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, count() AS rejects FROM siem.vpc_flow WHERE action = 'REJECT' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Credential & key activity (AU-2 highlighted | AssumeRole + KMS)
panels.description: sts:AssumeRole volume and KMS API activity — the two catalog-highlighted CloudTrail families.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t, family, c FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, 'AssumeRole' AS family, count() AS c FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE event_name = 'AssumeRole' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, 'KMS' AS family, count() AS c FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE event_source = 'kms.amazonaws.com' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t) ORDER BY t
